g.text: threshold = 0.5 | own successful samples | OpenJev: supplied aggregate, NOT sample-paired
OpenJev values are transcribed from the supplied summary; valid/error counts and model version are unconfirmed.
Latency for each model = mean of elapsed / processed over four complete runs (including failed requests).
N/A = missing quality result, single-class AUROC, or incomplete four-run timing; not zero.
Descriptive only, not a fair ranking. PII values measure presence detection, not masking quality.
